notes.title: Chaos Caves 1.1 adds the Moon... and Portals!
notes.content:
Today I've uploaded a new version! Headline features are the new biome and the new single-player mode (heresy!), shown together in this screenshot:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34246894/37e26995aa6f5843671e702ce4e57e696dbc6742.png[/img]

Release notes:

[list]
[*] New biome: The Moon, with low gravity and portals!
[*] New singleplayer mode: beat the turrets, some are protected by shields to test your parkour skills.
[*] Grenades now do frag damage.
[*] A marker now shows when the player is off screen top (useful for the Valley, necessary for the Moon!).
[*] Aim Stabilizer - holds aiming direction over rough terrain and when getting knocked about.
[*] Nuke tweaked with slightly more power, plus unremovable "radiation" buff.
[*] Grapple and Drill both tweaked for more power.
[*] Vehicle 4WD performance improved: more traction, suspension damping.
[*] Grapple can no longer be used as an OP shield (nice one Peter!).
[*] Performance optimizations on some hardware.
[*] Minor improvements: C4 arc color, laser cools differently in some biomes.
[*] Bug fixes: "All Different" mode, player disappearing and dying, player numbers, turret drooping over time, off-center boost/grapple torque, weapon random distribution, grenade UI behind terrain.
[/list]

Now begins another wave of new goodies, so be sure to join the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1004100/discussions/0/1742232339944803728/]beta branch[/url]  to stay up-to-date.

If you haven't gotten the game yet - head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1004100/Chaos_Caves/]store page[/url]!
